newsitem.title: LEBANON: Iran invites Lebanon to Islamic summit.
newsitem.headline: Iran invites Lebanon to Islamic summit.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati handed Lebanese President Elias Hrawi on Tuesday an invitation to attend an Islamic summit due to be held in Tehran in December.

"We came here to hand over a written invitation to President Hrawi through which his excellency is invited by Iranian President (Akbar Hashemi) Rafsanjani to attend the Islamic summit to be held next December in Tehran," Velayati said in Beirut.
Though Lebanese presidents are Maronite Christians, Lebanon is regularly invited to Islamic conferences as the majority of its population are Moslems.
Velayati is due to meet Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri later in the evening. He will hold talks with Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri on Wednesday morning before leaving to Syria.
